source: Starting point, not official. Bonedo solo workshop: Black Album amps were modified Marshalls and Mesa Mark IIC+ / IV; solo on the neck humbucker, an amp with plenty of gain, a light delay and some reverb. BG MARK3 is the closest Mesa. Amp knobs follow the Enter Sandman averages with more mid for the neck-pickup solo; delay and reverb values are estimates. Delay follows the pedal tempo (tap tempo).
